transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately or what brings you in today?

Yeah, hi. Um... I guess I'm just here because my mind won't stay on one thing anymore. 

It's causing issues at work. I'll be at the bench and... I don't know, I just jump around. I'll go from reading a customer email, to noticing a saw mark on a piece, to some random noise outside. And then I realize I've completely lost the work order I was supposed to be doing. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself moving around a lot when you're supposed to be staying focused or still?

I don't know if it's moving around, exactly. It's more... I just start doing too much. 

Like... recently, I started lining up a bunch of new commissions, messaging old customers... trying to build a website plan. I was sketching out this whole Appalachian collection all at once. It just felt like I had to get it all moving right then. So... yeah. I guess I wasn't really sitting still.
Do you find that you're often distracted by unrelated thoughts or stimuli, even when you're trying to focus on a task?

Yeah. Um... like I mentioned earlier, that's pretty much exactly what happens. I'll be trying to focus on a piece at the bench, and... a noise outside or just a scratch on the metal pulls me away. And then I completely lose track of the work order I was just looking at. So... yes.
Do you find yourself starting tasks at home and then switching to something else before finishing, or having trouble staying focused on one thing even when you’re not at work?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed it at home, I guess. I mostly just... keep to myself when I'm there. It's really just at the shop where it's been an issue.
Have you noticed any difficulty focusing or feeling restless in situations outside of work, like when you're relaxing at home or spending time with others?
Um... no, not really. Like I said, I just... I don't really do much at home. Just keep to myself. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you ever found it hard to pay attention or felt restless during meetings, conversations, or other structured social situations?

Um... I don't really go to meetings. And I don't socialize much, so... I don't know. I haven't really noticed it in conversations or anything. Like I said, I mostly just keep to myself outside of the shop.
Do you ever notice these same issues with distraction or restlessness in situations other than work—even if it's something like a hobby, errands, or just trying to relax?

I mean... I don't really know what else to say. It's just at work. I don't really have hobbies or anything like that. And when I run errands, I just... get what I need and go back home. I haven't noticed any issues then.
Do you ever notice these issues with distraction or restlessness when you're working on something you started yourself, like a personal project or even just planning something out at home?

I don't really do personal projects. But... I guess it's like I was saying before. It's really just at the bench. That's actually why I'm here. My mind just... it won't stay on one thing anymore. I'll be working, and then I'm looking at a customer email, and then I'm fixated on a saw mark on a piece, or I hear a noise outside... and then I realize I've completely lost track of the work order I was supposed to be doing. But it's just at work.

Have you ever noticed any similar issues with your mind wandering or restlessness, even if just slightly or for short periods, when you're doing anything else — like reading, watching something, or even just sitting with your thoughts?
No, not really. I mean, I don't read much. If I watch TV, I just kind of zone out. It's... it's just the shop. That's the only place it's a problem.

When you're at home and trying to plan something out, like organizing your day or even just figuring out what you need to do at the shop the next day, do you ever notice your mind wandering or having trouble staying focused on that plan?
I don't really sit around planning my day out like that. I just wake up and go in. So... no. Like I keep saying, it's really just when I'm actually at the bench.

Can you think of any time outside of work — even briefly — when you've felt your mind jumping around or being pulled away by small things, like when you're at home, running errands, or even just trying to relax?
No. I... I really can't. It's just at work. I don't know why we keep going over this. I'm fine at home.
Can you confirm that these issues with your mind wandering only happen at work and not in any other settings at all, even slightly?

Yeah. Just at work. That's... that's what brought me in, really. I just can't keep my mind on one thing at the bench anymore. I'll be looking at a customer email, and then I'll see a saw mark on a piece, and then I'll hear a car outside, and... then I realize I've completely lost track of the work order. It's just there. Nowhere else.
Can you recall any situation, even outside of work, where you felt your mind suddenly pulled away by small things or had trouble staying focused, even for a short time?
I... I feel like we just covered this. It's no. Just at the shop. I don't know what else to say.
As we're sitting here talking now, do you find your mind wandering or getting pulled away by things around the room, like sounds or objects?
No. I'm... I'm focused on what you're asking me. I'm just sitting here.
Do you ever feel a strong urge to do something without thinking it through, or find yourself acting quickly without considering the consequences, especially at work?
No, not really. I just do my work. I don't just... do things without thinking.

Do you ever notice these issues with your mind wandering or restlessness when you're in a more relaxed, unstructured setting — like when you're just hanging out or spending time with someone informally?
No. I mean... if I'm just at home or whatever, I'm just normal. I don't really get restless. I mostly just keep to myself anyway.

So far, you've said that these issues only happen at work and nowhere else. Is that consistently true—have you ever noticed even a small amount of mind-wandering or restlessness in other places, even once?
No, just at work. Like I said. I don't... it's not a problem anywhere else. Just when I'm there.
Have you ever had someone else, like a coworker or customer, mention that you seemed distracted or restless at work, even if you weren't aware of it yourself?
No, I don't think so. Nobody's ever said anything to me about it. People mostly just leave me alone to do my job.

Have you ever had trouble focusing or felt restless in any other setting when there were competing distractions or demands, even if it wasn’t at home or work — like in school, during travel, or in a busy environment?
No, not really. I don't... I don't really go out to busy places much anyway. Just work and home. And school was fine, I guess. It's really just at work.
Have you ever noticed these same issues with distraction or restlessness in any other work-like settings or environments that require focus, even if not at your current job?
No... I don't really do anything else like that. Just my job. So... no. Just at work.
